description: Use the parser native ASK/TELL actor-command path, add legal HELP WITH syntax, and centralize bounded Mara cooperation by real object.

replacements.old:
<SYNTAX ASK OBJECT (FIND ACTORBIT) TO MOVE OBJECT (FIND) = V-R1277-ASK-MOVE>
<SYNTAX ASK OBJECT (FIND ACTORBIT) TO CARRY OBJECT (FIND) = V-R1277-ASK-MOVE>
<SYNTAX ASK OBJECT (FIND ACTORBIT) TO HELP WITH OBJECT (FIND) = V-R1277-ASK-MOVE>

<ROUTINE V-R1277-ASK-MOVE ()
    <COND (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA>>
           <TELL "That request grammar is reserved for an autonomous companion who can answer it." CR>)
          (<NOT <R1277-REQUESTABLE-OBJECT? ,PRSI>>
           <TELL "Mara looks at the requested object. That is not one of the bounded cooperative moves she and you have actually worked out." CR>)
          (<NOT <MARA-HERE?>>
           <TELL "Mara is not here to hear or evaluate the request." CR>)
          (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-PERIL>
           <TELL "Not now, Mara says. Immediate danger outranks rearranging the House." CR>)
          (<AND <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-INJURY>
                <ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LADDER-RECOVERED>>>
           <TELL "Mara tests the injured shoulder and stops. No, she says. I can help plan the route, but I am not putting that load through this shoulder before it heals." CR>)
          (<MARA-RUPTURE-OPEN?>
           <TELL "Mara looks at you, then the " D ,PRSI ". If somebody is trapped, I help. Optional close hauling while the rupture is still open? No. The current boundary is distance, not obedience with furniture." CR>)
          (<AND <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-BIO-BROKE-PROMISE>
                <ZERO? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-BIO-ROPE-RETURNED>>>
           <TELL "Mara looks at you, then the " D ,PRSI ". You still have an entrusted-rope fact left physically unresolved, she says. I am not adding optional close hauling on top of unrepaired custody." CR>)
          (<AND <R1277-GET ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-PROMISE>
                <NOT <EQUAL? <R1277-GET ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-PROMISE> ,PRSI>>>
           <TELL "Mara shakes her head. I already promised to revisit the " D <R1277-GET ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-PROMISE> " when we reach it. I am not stacking another invisible job behind that one." CR>)
          (<NOT <EQUAL? <LOC ,PRSI> ,HERE>>
           <R1277-PUT ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-PROMISE ,PRSI>
           <R1277-HOUSE-PUT ,R1277-HS-PROMISE-NOTED 0>
           <TELL "Mara considers where the actual " D ,PRSI " is. I will help when we are both with it, she says. That is a real promise to revisit the lift, not permission to teleport anything here." CR>)
          (T
           <R1277-PUT ,R1277-SLOT-MARA-HELPING ,PRSI>
           <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,RUG> <EQUAL? ,HERE ,WEST-OF-HOUSE>>
                  <TELL "Mara looks from the oriental carpet to the boarded entrance. There isn't even a porch, she says. Then she takes the other end. Fine. Your imaginary welcome mat." CR>)
                 (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-BIO-BROKE-PROMISE>
                  <TELL "Mara checks the " D ,PRSI ", the route, and her own footing. I remember the promise you broke, she says. I also remember that the rope eventually came back and that later choices became new evidence. All right. You take that end." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "Mara checks the " D ,PRSI ", the route, and her own footing. All right, she says. You take that end. She is agreeing to this move, not surrendering judgment over every command that can be typed." CR>)>)>
    <RTRUE>>

           <TELL "That request grammar is reserved for an autonomous companion who can answer it." CR>)
          (T <R1277-MARA-REQUEST-OBJECT ,PRSI>)>

<ROUTINE V-R1277-MARA-HELP ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,WINNER ,MARA>
           <R1277-MARA-REQUEST-OBJECT ,PRSO>)
          (T
           <TELL "Name the person you are asking to help; this is not a generic invisible-assistant command." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>
